# Tamila Aspen — Denver Real Estate Agent & Mortgage Loan Officer

> Tamila Aspen is a REALTOR® (Colorado license #100077895, brokered by Equity Colorado Real Estate) and a mortgage loan originator (NMLS #2490507, Barrett Financial Group, LLC, NMLS #181106) serving the Denver metro and Colorado Springs. She lists homes for a 1% listing fee when the seller also buys their next home with her (listing only: standard rate, up to 3%). She speaks English, Russian and Ukrainian.

## Key facts
- Office: 7887 E Belleview Ave, Suite 175, Centennial, CO 80111. Phone: (720) 975-6206. Email: aspenprohomes@gmail.com
- Background: born in Kyiv, Ukraine; in the U.S. since 2001; Master's degree in Economics; 23 years in finance and accounting; 10 years in real estate and lending
- Designations: ABR, SRS, PSA, MRP (Military Relocation Professional), RCS-D (divorce), SFR (short sales & foreclosures)
- Awards: 2024 Outstanding Sales Performance and Power Professional Award (October 2024), Equity Colorado Real Estate
- Reviews: 5.0 on Google; reviews on Zillow and Realtor.com
- Mortgage: FHA, VA, USDA, Conventional, Jumbo, Non-QM, down payment assistance; works with credit scores starting around 570; licensed in Colorado and Florida
- Military: her son serves in the U.S. Air Force; helps with VA loans and PCS moves near Buckley SFB, Fort Carson, Peterson SFB, Schriever SFB and the Air Force Academy
- Service areas: Denver, Aurora, Centennial, Highlands Ranch, Littleton, Parker, Thornton, Lakewood, Englewood, Arvada, Commerce City, Brighton, Colorado Springs, Monument, Larkspur
